Zoe: ok serious pet thread — Herbie (my parakeet) discovered sinks today. photo dump 📸
Zoe: https://photos.internal/zoe/herbie-sink-1.jpg (tiny gif of a sploosh)
Raj: no way 😂 he looks like he's auditioning for synchronized swimming
Marta: teach me your ways. mine refuses water and judges me
Lin: :heart_eyes: that's the tail flick at 0:02
Jules: How do you get him to step onto the faucet area? i'm picturing a tiny plumber
Zoe: @Jules patience + millet. steps: 1) shallow dish 2) millet nearby 3) towel ready. `towel = mandatory`
Raj: also PSA — towels are gross but necessary. had feathers in drain for days
Marta: sending a sticker. Herbie is a king
ArtemisBot: Reminder: photo thread is fine but please don't post identifiable home addresses or personal contact info
Zoe: thanks bot. no addresses here, promise :grin:
